import csv
import re

# Load the JSON catalog
with open('inputs/catalog/dataeuropa_mobility_catalog_sample.json', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    catalog = json.load(f)

datasets = catalog.get('datasets', [])

    r'\bmobilit\b',
    r'\bgtfs\b',
    r'\bpublic\s+transport\b',
    r'\btransit\b',
    r'\btransport\b',
    r'\btraffic\b',
    r'\broad\b',
    r'\brail\b',
    r'\bus\s+transit\b',
    r'\bpublic\s+transit\b',
    r'\burban\s+mobilit\b',
    r'\bcommut\b',
    r'\bjourney\b',
    r'\broute\b',
    r'\bschedule\b',
    r'\bstop\s+.*\b',
    r'\btrip\b',
    r'\bvehicle\b',
    r'\broad\s+network\b',
    r'\broad\s+infrastructure\b',
    r'\broad\s+transport\b',
    r'\broad\s+traffic\b',
]

    title = ds.get('title', '')
    description = ds.get('description', '')
    keywords = ds.get('keywords', [])
    keywords_str = ' '.join(keywords) if isinstance(keywords, list) else str(keywords)

    return False

    description = ds.get('description', '').lower()

        'data portal',
        'open data portal',
        'data catalogue',
        'data catalog',
        'discovery service',
        'geo data portal',
        'data hub',
        'data gateway',
        'teabev\u00e4rav',  # Estonian data gateway
        'directorat-general',
        'agency for',
        'european centre',
        'european fisheries',
        'consumers, health',
        'european climate',
        'council of the european',
        'european committee',
        'community plant',
        'translation centre',
        'european union agency',
    ]

        if indicator in title or indicator in description:
            return True
    return False

        mobility_datasets.append(ds)

    if ds not in mobility_datasets:
        title = ds.get('title', '')
        description = ds.get('description', '')
        keywords = ds.get('keywords', [])
        keywords_str = ' '.join(keywords) if isinstance(keywords, list) else str(keywords)
        
        text = f"{title} {description} {keywords_str}".lower()
        
        # Check specifically for mobility category mention
        if 'mobility' in text and not is_generic_portal(ds):
            # Check if it's specifically about mobility data (not just a portal that has mobility category)
            if 'hvd' in text and 'mobility' in text:
                # This is a catalog that includes mobility HVDs - but it's a catalog itself
                # Skip generic catalogs unless they specifically describe mobility data
                pass

# Write CSV
with open('outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['dataset_id', 'title', 'description', 'publisher', 'country', 'formats', 'license', 'distribution_url', 'keywords'])
    
    for ds in mobility_datasets:
        dataset_id = ds.get('id', '')
        title = ds.get('title', '')
        description = ds.get('description', '')
        publisher = ds.get('publisher', '')
        country = ds.get('country', '')
        license = ds.get('license', '')
        keywords = ds.get('keywords', [])
        keywords_str = '; '.join(keywords) if isinstance(keywords, list) else str(keywords)
        
        distributions = ds.get('distributions', [])
        formats = []
        urls = []
        for dist in distributions:
            fmt = dist.get('format', '')
            url = dist.get('downloadURL', '')
            if fmt:
                formats.append(fmt)
            if url:
                urls.append(url)
        
        formats_str = '; '.join(formats) if formats else ''
        url_str = '; '.join(urls) if urls else ''
        
        writer.writerow([dataset_id, title, description, publisher, country, formats_str, license, url_str, keywords_str])

print(f"Extracted {len(mobility_datasets)} mobility-related datasets.")
for ds in mobility_datasets:
    print(f"  - {ds['id']}: {ds['title']}")
